description:
LeftLane connects ChatGPT to your dealership’s real data. Ask about active inventory, past-due finance accounts, or metrics like collections, accounts receivable, and delinquency. Open a customer deal for terms, parties, vehicle, and finance details, or add a comment on a vehicle, deal, or finance account.

Sign in with your LeftLane account; access stays scoped to your dealership’s permissions.

defaultPrompt: Add recommendations as comments on finance accounts that are at least 30 days past due
Summarize collections revenue for this month
What kind of vehicle sells the best at my dealership?
